in_sanskrit.name: त्रिष्णु
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: त्रितया कामनात्मकानां त्रिष्णुः (tritayā kāmātmakānāṃ triṣṇuḥ) - The one who fulfills the three desires of the three gods - Brahma, Vishnu and Mahesh (Shiva).

in_hindi.name: त्रिष्णा
in_hindi.meaning: तीने कामों का पूरकार (tīne kāmōṃ kā pūrakār) - Fulfiller of the three desires
in_hindi.long_meaning: त्रितया कामों से सकारात्मा (tritayā kāmōṃ se sakārātmā) - The one who fulfills the three desires of the three gods - Brahma, Vishnu and Mahesh (Shiva).

in_tamil.name: திருஷ்ணன்
in_tamil.meaning: திரு (thiru) - Divine, ஷண் (ṣṇa) - Shiva, னன் (ñaṉ) - One
in_tamil.long_meaning: திருஷ்ணன் (thiruṣṇaṉ) - The one who is divine and represents Shiva.

in_telugu.name: తృష్ణ
in_telugu.long_meaning: తృష్ణ (tṛṣṇa) - The one who is the god of the three desires - Brahma, Vishnu and Mahesh (Shiva).

in_marathi.name: Trishaan
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God of Rudra
in_marathi.long_meaning: Trishaan हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Trishaan is a name derived from the Hindu deity Rudra. It is believed to represent strength, loyalty, and victory. In Hindu mythology, Rudra is a god associated with destruction, chaos, and primal energy.
